name: Gaps
summary: This EA trades price gaps (window gaps) that occur between candle closes and opens, entering positions in the direction of gap fill expectation. It identifies gaps on the current timeframe and places market orders expecting the gap to be closed by price retracement.
summary_zh: 该EA交易K线之间的价格跳空缺口，在缺口出现后入场，预期价格会回补缺口。它在当前时间周期上识别跳空缺口，并下市价单等待缺口回补获利。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于价格跳空缺口回补理论，即市场出现跳空缺口后价格倾向于回补缺口。入场条件为检测到当前K线开盘价与前一根K线收盘价之间存在显著缺口，向上缺口做空预期回补，向下缺口做多预期回补。出场条件通常为缺口完全回补时获利了结，或设置止损在缺口另一侧一定距离处。仓位管理一般使用固定手数或基于账户资金的百分比计算。资金管理方面可能包含简单的止损止盈比例控制，但缺乏复杂的资金管理模块。该策略的核心假设是缺口回补的概率较高，但在强趋势中缺口可能不会被回补而导致亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the gap fill theory, which posits that price tends to retrace and fill gaps that occur between candle closes and opens. Entry conditions detect a significant price gap between the current candle open and the previous candle close — an upward gap triggers a sell order expecting gap fill, while a downward gap triggers a buy order. Exit conditions typically involve take-profit at the gap fill level, with stop-loss placed at a calculated distance beyond the gap. Position sizing generally uses fixed lot sizes or a percentage of account equity. Money management may include basic stop-loss and take-profit ratio controls but lacks sophisticated money management modules. The core assumption is that gaps have a high probability of being filled, but in strong trending markets gaps may persist without being filled, leading to losses.

parameters.name: LotSize
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size (used when MMRec disabled)

parameters.name: GapMinimumPoints
parameters.description: 最小缺口点数阈值，低于此值不交易
parameters.description_en: Minimum gap points threshold; no trade below this

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，通常设在缺口回补位
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, typically set at gap close

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于区分订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

pros: 缺口回补是经过验证的统计现象，在多数市场条件下具有较高的胜率
策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证，参数较少便于优化
入场条件明确客观，不受主观判断影响，适合系统化交易
pros_en: Gap fill is a statistically validated phenomenon with relatively high win rate across most market conditions
Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and verify, with few parameters for optimization
Entry conditions are objective and well-defined, free from subjective judgment, suitable for systematic trading
cons: 在强趋势行情中缺口可能不会回补，导致较大亏损
缺乏多时间周期确认，可能在错误的时间周期上交易虚假缺口
没有考虑交易成本和滑点对缺口回补利润的侵蚀效应
cons_en: In strong trending markets gaps may not fill, leading to significant losses
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, potentially trading false gaps on the wrong timeframe
Does not account for the erosion of gap fill profits by trading costs and slippage
improvements: 增加多时间周期缺口确认机制，过滤低质量缺口信号
加入趋势过滤器，在强趋势中避免逆势交易缺口回补
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe gap confirmation mechanism to filter low-quality gap signals
Incorporate a trend filter to avoid counter-trend gap fill trading during strong trends

risk_points: 缺口不回补风险：强趋势中缺口可能持续扩大而非回补，导致止损被触发
周末缺口风险：周一开盘缺口可能因流动性不足而滑点严重，止损可能无效
risk_points_en: Gap non-fill risk: In strong trends, gaps may widen instead of filling, triggering stop-losses
Weekend gap risk: Monday opening gaps may suffer severe slippage due to low liquidity, making stop-losses ineffective

summary_en: This EA trades price gaps (window gaps) that occur between candle closes and opens, entering positions in the direction of gap fill expectation. It identifies gaps on the current timeframe and places market orders expecting the gap to be closed by price retracement.
